notes: Mathlib proof A054120b_conjecture: for all n, k, T(n,k) = A081577(n,k) - [n>=2, k>=1] A081577(n-2,k-1), T defined by the between-the-vertical-lines sum. Proves Hendel's recurrence (McGarvey's first conjecture) from the definition (A054120_rec), the same recurrence for the zero-extended A081577 triangle, then induction on n with base rows 0..2. Outside Lean: the reading of the geometric definition (centred position 2j-i).

sources.what: Hendel's 2015 proof of the first McGarvey recurrence; Mathar 2022 g.f. remark (equivalent, unproved)

prior_art.note: A short induction once Hendel's recurrence is known; no written proof of the second conjecture found.
